astra_M_derivations.claim_title: The player's contribution must actually occur
Learning can alter the conditions of further learning
Finite attention creates opportunity costs without a points economy
Better evidence need not provide the answer
Competence is local and revisable, not necessarily powerless
History changes the meaning of repetition
Failure may leave a playable situation, not a reset demand
Deepening has both discovery and creation
Independent return does not require escalating content
Friction can revise the player's own assumptions
The interface can preserve or consume the very faculty being exercised
Meaningful history must survive beyond transcript recall
Contrast between independent lives may accumulate in the user
Shared roots permit comparison, not a conquest ladder
Retrospective reflection can be useful without a verdict on the self
Universal relational progress and external metagames
